title: The Last Gem
text: Tom and his two friends play Brawl Stars every Friday after school.
Tom always plays as Shelly, because she is very strong.
Last Friday they played Gem Grab.
You need ten gems to win, and the other team had nine.
Tom's friends were tired, but Tom didn't stop.
He took the last gem and hid in a bush until the end.
They won, and Tom's mum heard him shout "Yes!" from the kitchen.
